subject: [PATCH v5 3/8] mm/gup: convert follow_page_mask() to return a long

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch converts the return type of the follow_page_mask() function from a struct page pointer to a long integer. The new return value can be 0, a negative errno, or 1 with the found page stored in a pages[0] slot. This change allows the return type to carry a page count instead of a single struct page pointer.
